tiles.text: Three papers on 14 October. Three working implementations a week later.

cram crams a long document into a KV cache 8–32× smaller by training the cache instead of evicting from it. At 8× on Qwen3-0.6B, eviction keeps 5% of phone-number lookups; cram keeps 90%. About 600 lines, for any Hugging Face decoder.

elastify cuts a Hugging Face transformer to any size at runtime from one 38 KB ranking file, with no retraining. MiniLM with 60% of its FLOPs removed keeps 77% of its SciFact retrieval quality and runs 1.69× faster.

lethe is the forgetting harness from Tan et al. in under 1,000 lines of dependency-free Python. Agents are any OpenAI-compatible model or Claude Code; every attempt is a git commit, and the judges cannot be edited by the code they score.

Latent Compaction with Test-Time Training (Chen et al.): treat a document's KV cache as a small network and train it with the model frozen. 96.7% on RULER at 32× compression, against 40.0% for KVZip+.

Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting (Tan et al.): agents that iterate on a program get anchored to their own history. Wiping every session and restarting the team from its best candidate beats both one agent and four in parallel, at the same budget.

Your Transformer Is Secretly Elastic (Simoncini et al.): one learned ranking of neurons and heads prunes a pretrained transformer to any size. DINOv3 ViT-H+/16 at 50% sparsity loses 427M parameters and 0.8% ImageNet accuracy.
